title: Chunk with overlap (Python)
description: Split a string into chunks of 4 characters with 1 character of overlap.
starterCode:
text = "abcdefghij"
size, overlap = 4, 1
step = size - overlap
chunks = [text[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(text) - overlap, step)]
print(chunks)

title: Cosine similarity (Python)
description: Compute the cosine similarity of two vectors that point in the same direction.
starterCode:
import math
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = [2, 4, 6]
dot = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
norm = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a)) * math.sqrt(sum(y * y for y in b))
print(round(dot / norm, 2))

title: Redact an email (Python)
description: Replace an email address with a redaction token.
starterCode:
